name: prompt-pack
description: Universal Agent Prompt Deck — static HTML/CSS/JS deck of 287 agent prompts.

scripts.check:rust: cargo fmt --manifest-path generator/Cargo.toml -- --check && cargo test --manifest-path generator/Cargo.toml --offline
scripts.check: npm run check:data && npm run check:tokens && npm run check:contrast && npm run check:arch && npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run check:rust
scripts.test: npm run check && npm run smoke
scripts.build: cargo build --manifest-path generator/Cargo.toml --target wasm32-unknown-unknown --release --offline && node scripts/build-pages.mjs
